en.headline: New World Development proposes 1-for-11 rights issue to raise HK$24.9 billion
en.dek: The developer said the fully underwritten offer at HK$0.90 a share, backed by Chow Tai Fook Enterprises, would fund debt refinancing and projects, with trading set to resume on Monday.
body: New World Development announced on Sunday a proposed fully underwritten rights issue of 11 shares for every one existing share held, priced at HK$0.90 each, to raise about HK$24.9 billion gross.

The price represents a discount of roughly 81.5 per cent to the HK$4.87 closing price before the recent suspension and about 26.9 per cent to the theoretical ex-rights price of HK$1.23. Net proceeds are expected to be around HK$24.1 billion after costs. The issue of about 27.7 billion new shares is underwritten by controlling shareholder Chow Tai Fook Enterprises, HSBC and DBS.

The company said the proceeds would be used for bank loan refinancing, debt repayment and funding for development projects. It also proposed immediately repaying 10 per cent of the outstanding principal on a HK$82 billion target offshore bank loan and extending the maturity of the remaining 90 per cent by two years. Chairman Cheng Kar-shing said the combination of equity raising and debt extension aimed to meet short-term funding needs while giving the business more flexibility to realise asset value in an orderly way. The proposal is subject to independent shareholder approval, a whitewash waiver and binding agreements with lenders. Trading in the shares is due to resume at 9am on Monday.

zh.headline: 新世界發展建議「1供11」供股 集資約249億元
zh.dek: 每股供股價0.9元，由周大福企業、匯豐及星展包銷，所得款項用於再融資及償債，股份周一復牌。
body: 新世界發展周日公布，建議以合資格股東每持有1股獲發11股供股股份的基準，進行全額包銷供股，每股認購價0.9元，籌集約249億元。
供股價較停牌前收市價4.87元折讓約81.5%，較理論除權價1.23元折讓約26.9%。扣除開支後淨額約241億元。約276.8億股新股由控股股東周大福企業、匯豐及星展擔任包銷商。
公司表示，所得款項淨額將用於銀行貸款再融資、償付債務及為待發展項目提供資金。同時建議即時提前償邂820億元目標境外銀行貸款未償還本金的10%，並將餘下90%的最終到期日延長兩年。主席鄭家純表示，結合股本集資與延長債務到期日，旨在應對短期資金需求，同時讓業務有更大靈活性，以有序方式實現資產價值。建議須待獨立股東批准、清洗豁免及與貸款人簽署具約束力協議等條件達成。股份將於周一上午9時復牌。
